rows.meaning: A serial usually appears on the first row of a voucher. Blank continuation serials are expected.
Four source labels identify the operating unit.
Three Mumbai units share the same recorded registration; Bengaluru uses a different one. These are not four separate legal entities established by this export.
Primary grouping field within a unit. Supplier invoice reference is Bill No.
Text dates in the source; posting-date interpretation is inferred from voucher structure.
Includes suppliers, individuals, utilities and internal settlement control accounts.
Blank and dash values occur. Unvalidated source values are not proof of registration or ITC eligibility.
Exempted, Taxable and Common. Do not use this field alone to determine statutory treatment.
Recorded label may not match item nature; books and study materials also appear under Service.
Contains 4-, 6- and 8-digit values and placeholders such as NA, Na and dash. A numeric format is not a validated tax code.
Sometimes a receipt, statement or internal reference. Not globally unique.
Can precede the period; two missing dates and two years recorded as 2002 need review.
Detail-level amount in INR; negative adjustments are retained.
Sparse where no corresponding component is recorded. Component duplication occurs on one row.
Sparse where no corresponding component is recorded.
Often separate from CGST/SGST; one row records all three while Total GST includes only one tax amount.
Entirely blank. Its economic or calculation meaning cannot be established from these files.
Reconciles gross to basic on every monetary row. One disagreement with component sum remains.
Numeric rates 5, 12, 18 and 40. Blank rates occur where no GST is recorded.
Basic Amt plus recorded Total GST on all 2,617 monetary rows. Not a reconciled total bill or cash payment.
All 1,183 populated values are negative. Aggregate with its sign; do not subtract a negative twice.
Usually populated once per voucher, but 212 monetary vouchers do not reconcile with aggregated gross plus signed TDS.
90 distinct source labels, including capital work in progress and opaque List No. headings.
269 distinct labels; needed to interpret generic account heads and map comparable categories.
2,339 populated cells, aligned to voucher-start rows. Includes dates, service descriptions and occasionally personal/payment identifiers; these identifiers are omitted from this report.
Entirely blank. Department-wise spend, budget ownership and cost-centre analysis are unavailable.

rows.finding: Net Amt does not reconcile
rows.evidence: 9.1% of monetary vouchers; absolute differences total INR 5,642,456.10 and signed differences INR 2,802,455.58. These are export-scope discrepancies, not proven loss or overpayment.
rows.action: Reconcile original voucher lines, gross, TDS and net scope before payment/payable reporting.

rows.finding: Entire vouchers have no financial amounts
rows.evidence: Eight PGDM August vouchers have no Basic, GST, Gross, TDS or Net values. Their value is unknown.
rows.action: Obtain a complete re-export and reconcile against the voucher ledger.

rows.finding: Department is entirely empty
rows.evidence: Department is blank on every row.
rows.action: Capture a governed department/cost-centre owner and, where needed, allocation percentages.

rows.finding: Tax Type meaning is unresolved
rows.evidence: 1,221 GST-bearing lines are labelled Exempted and carry INR 18,827,470.90 recorded GST.
rows.action: Confirm ERP semantics and input-credit treatment using the original tax settings; do not infer treatment from this label.

rows.finding: GST component sum disagrees with Total GST
rows.evidence: PGDM row 371 records CGST 8,845.20, SGST 8,845.20 and IGST 17,690.40, but Total GST is 17,690.40.
rows.action: Inspect original tax ledger and bill; avoid adding the three components as an unquestioned tax total.

rows.finding: HSN/SAC is absent or a placeholder
rows.evidence: 1,050 monetary rows; INR 73,626,877.09 gross. 159 GST-bearing rows lack a usable HSN/SAC and carry INR 3,183,725.91 GST.
rows.action: Normalize placeholders and validate codes against source bills and the applicable master.

rows.finding: Party GSTIN is absent or a placeholder
rows.evidence: 802 monetary rows; INR 43,112,602.71 gross. Some are unregistered persons, utilities or control accounts; absence alone is not an error.
rows.action: Classify payee/registration status and request identifiers where appropriate. Three GST-bearing rows have a blank identifier.

rows.finding: HSN/SAC digit length needs review
rows.evidence: Eight non-placeholder code entries have unusual digit lengths. Separately, 89 Na labels are placeholders.
rows.action: Review against original documents; do not pad/truncate code strings automatically.

rows.finding: Party GSTIN format/type needs review
rows.evidence: 25 non-placeholder rows do not match the standard case-sensitive shape. Two are lowercase-only issues and eight use a different registration suffix.
rows.action: Uppercase safely, distinguish registration types, and verify the remaining values from a counterparty master.

rows.finding: Bill date is missing
rows.action: Recover bill dates before lag and cutoff reporting.

rows.finding: Bill years are recorded as 2002
rows.evidence: PGDM row 809 and University row 178; artificial lags exceed 8,700 days.
rows.action: Confirm dates from original bills; do not auto-correct the year.

rows.finding: Repeated supplier bill references
rows.evidence: Five within-unit supplier/bill/date groups span ten vouchers. Every pair has different gross amounts. No duplication conclusion follows.
rows.action: Check whether these are allocations, distinct components or erroneous repeat postings.

rows.finding: Negative adjustments need a separate type
rows.evidence: All 25 negative gross lines are in PGDM and total INR -117,223.00; retained in net recorded gross.
rows.action: Classify credit notes, reversals and rounding adjustments; do not remove or make absolute.

rows.finding: Taxable label has no recorded GST
rows.evidence: 49 rows marked Taxable have no recorded GST; source-specific treatment may explain this.
rows.action: Review source semantics and tax authority before treating these as missing tax.

source.label: Quality findings from source profiling and deterministic arithmetic checks. Findings overlap; counts must not be added to infer defective rows or financial loss.

source.period: 1 April to 30 September 2026 (Date column); bill dates differ
filters: Only the four supplied workbooks. All header-matching rows included. The Date column is treated as posting date.
caveats: Recorded gross detail is not reconciled complete-bill value or cash paid.
Blank whole-voucher amounts remain unknown. TDS is signed; its absence is retained as unreported.
Counterparty tax identifiers are masked. Contact/payment references in narration are omitted. Source bill references remain available.

metricDefinitions.label: Recorded gross
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of populated Gross Amt cells in the selected original detail rows. All-missing selections are unavailable; this is not reconciled billed expenditure or payments.

metricDefinitions.label: Recorded GST
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of populated Total GST cells. No recorded GST is shown as unavailable where all cells are unreported; component sums are checked separately.

metricDefinitions.label: Internal vouchers
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct unit plus Inv No. Includes unvalued vouchers; header-level metrics retain complete original voucher scope.

metricDefinitions.label: Net exception
metricDefinitions.definition: A monetary voucher with abs(Net Amt - summed Gross Amt - signed TDS) greater than INR 1. A reconciliation exception is not established financial loss or overpayment.

evidenceFlow.title: Read the supplied registers
evidenceFlow.detail: Each file has one sheet named Purchase HSN DetailsReport. Header rows: Autonomous 8, Bengaluru 7, PGDM 7, University 8. Column D is a blank merge companion to entity GSTIN, not a data field.

evidenceFlow.title: Preserve transaction grain
evidenceFlow.detail: Read all rows with Inv No. Treat unit plus Inv No as the internal-voucher key. Sum detail N/U/S and signed TDS V; sum populated W once per voucher. A continuation row is not a new invoice.

evidenceFlow.title: Prepare this result
evidenceFlow.detail: Workbook and unit summaries. Monetary amounts are sums of recorded columns in INR; gross value includes GST and negative adjustments. Party counts are recorded names, including control accounts.

evidenceFlow.title: Build the interactive portal
evidenceFlow.detail: Retain 2,632 detail records and 2,339 internal vouchers. Apply unit/date/record filters before computing every affected view. Monetary sums ignore unreported cells; all-unreported scopes return unavailable. Distinct vouchers use unit plus Inv No. No tax conclusion or payment state is inferred.

methods.code: One original Excel detail row; all 2,632 rows including 15 without amounts. N/U/S are line values. TDS and Net usually occur once per voucher. Values preserve source signs. Derived in analysis/build_portal_data.py from the previously verified local extraction; no workbook values were changed.

source.period: 1 April to 30 September 2026 (Date column); bill dates differ
filters: Only the four supplied workbooks. All header-matching rows included. The Date column is treated as posting date.
caveats: Recorded gross detail is not reconciled complete-bill value or cash paid.
Blank whole-voucher amounts remain unknown. TDS is signed; its absence is retained as unreported.
Counterparty tax identifiers are masked. Contact/payment references in narration are omitted. Source bill references remain available.

metricDefinitions.label: Recorded gross
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of populated Gross Amt cells in the selected original detail rows. All-missing selections are unavailable; this is not reconciled billed expenditure or payments.

metricDefinitions.label: Recorded GST
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of populated Total GST cells. No recorded GST is shown as unavailable where all cells are unreported; component sums are checked separately.

metricDefinitions.label: Internal vouchers
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct unit plus Inv No. Includes unvalued vouchers; header-level metrics retain complete original voucher scope.

metricDefinitions.label: Net exception
metricDefinitions.definition: A monetary voucher with abs(Net Amt - summed Gross Amt - signed TDS) greater than INR 1. A reconciliation exception is not established financial loss or overpayment.

evidenceFlow.title: Read the supplied registers
evidenceFlow.detail: Each file has one sheet named Purchase HSN DetailsReport. Header rows: Autonomous 8, Bengaluru 7, PGDM 7, University 8. Column D is a blank merge companion to entity GSTIN, not a data field.

evidenceFlow.title: Preserve transaction grain
evidenceFlow.detail: Read all rows with Inv No. Treat unit plus Inv No as the internal-voucher key. Sum detail N/U/S and signed TDS V; sum populated W once per voucher. A continuation row is not a new invoice.

evidenceFlow.title: Prepare this result
evidenceFlow.detail: Workbook and unit summaries. Monetary amounts are sums of recorded columns in INR; gross value includes GST and negative adjustments. Party counts are recorded names, including control accounts.

evidenceFlow.title: Build the interactive portal
evidenceFlow.detail: Retain 2,632 detail records and 2,339 internal vouchers. Apply unit/date/record filters before computing every affected view. Monetary sums ignore unreported cells; all-unreported scopes return unavailable. Distinct vouchers use unit plus Inv No. No tax conclusion or payment state is inferred.
